methodology.three_files_complete: opportunities.json and evidence.json parse as JSON; report.md is present and nonempty
methodology.artifact_denominator: All entries in result/evidence.json.artifacts; entries may be snapshots or derived documents, not independently authenticated official originals
methodology.path_resolution: Use local_path only; absolute path must resolve inside its own run; runs/<exact_run_id>/... is relative to PoC; all other relative paths are relative to own run. Resolve links before opening. Never use remote_path, basename searching, cross-run substitution or network recovery.
methodology.hash: SHA256 of actual read_bytes versus a valid 64-hex artifacts[i].sha256; null/empty is missing_hash; absent evidence.json contributes zero declarations but is not a successful empty delivery.
methodology.projection_check: Structural diagnostic only: nested vs facts_flat field/value/status/note and artifact_id/quote/locator/sha256; entity ID/name/code/kind/parent consistency. Not semantic or human verification.
methodology.model: DB model is configured/requested metadata only. WMA session_info_update and usage_update payloads inspected for public model fields; no returned model captured. Current runner uses default session without passing cfg.model.
methodology.excluded: No case prompts, seed URLs, cloud IDs, credential values, contacts, original text, quotes, thought/reasoning or arbitrary logs exported. Local run_id and artifact ordinal retained for audit.
